description: This file defines the BCMDataExportsClient class, which extends AwsClient, providing methods to interact with the AWS Billing and Cost Management Data Exports service. It includes method annotations for synchronous and asynchronous calls related to exports, tags, and retrieval of resources.

classes.name: BCMDataExportsClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Billing and Cost Management Data Exports service, providing methods to manage exports, retrieve data, and handle tags asynchronously and synchronously.

methods.name: createExport
methods.description: Creates a new export with specified parameters.

methods.name: getExecution
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific execution.

methods.name: getExport
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific export.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Fetches details about a specific table.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.
